name: [FIX] Army Simulator🎖
desc:
Welcome to Army Simulator! 

Update Log: 
-Added two new missions 
-Added Radio Commands
-Outfits now save

Train to become one of the best soldiers on the battlefield by going through the harsh environment of what an actual soldier may experience in real life. Once you've finished your training's, you'll embark on a difficult mission where you'll fight to liberate Vietnam! 

Becoming the highest ranking officer in the server will allow you to take command of your squad!

Map By TheGreatArchimedes
